source_title: HP High Court result 2026 expected soon after final answer key release; check updates for 388 posts - The Times of India
source_excerpt: The High Court of Himachal Pradesh is expected to announce the results for the recruitment of Court Manager, Stenographer Grade-III and Driver posts soon. The development comes after the High Court released the final answer keys for the written examinations conducted on October 10 and October 11, 2026.Candidates who appeared for the screening test will be able to check and download their results from the official website of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh once they are declared.The recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 388 vacancies in the Establishment of District Judiciary in Himachal Pradesh.The release of the final answer key is an important stage in the recruitment process. Unlike the provisional answer key, the final answer key is issued after the examination authority has considered objections, where applicable, and finalised the answers.While the High Court has not announced an official date for the declaration of the HP High Court result 2026, candidates can expect an update on the result after the release of the final answer key. Candidates are advised to rely only on the official website for updates regarding the result and subsequent stages of the recruitment process.HP High Court result 2026: What happens after the result?Candidates shortlisted on the basis of the written examination will have to participate in the next stage of the selection process, depending on the post for which they have applied.The recruitment process includes different stages such as:Screening TestWritten TestProficiency TestSkill TestTrade TestViva-Voce, wherever applicableThe selection stages will vary according to the requirements of the post. Candidates should carefully check the official notification and future notices issued by the High Court for post-wise selection details.HP High Court result 2026: Steps to download scorecardCandidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the HP High Court result 2026 on the official website:Visit the official website of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh.Go to the recruitment or latest notifications section on the homepage.Look for the link related to HP High Court Result 2026 for Court Manager, Stenographer Grade-III or Driver posts.Click on the relevant result link.Download the result PDF or enter the required login details, if applicable.Check the result and save a copy for future reference.Candidates are advised to stay tuned to the official website to get the complete details of the HP High Court recruitment 2026.Get the latest Education News and Live updates.
